messages.author: 6d516dae6aab4320
messages.subject: Error when running  has_devel()
parts:
Hey everyone,

I'm reading the Getting Started guide on Hadley Wickham book on R packages. I installed Rtools33 (which is the latest unfrozen Rtools version) and then ran into an error when I tried to run the following in order to check I installed everything correctly:
 
> library(devtools)
> has_devel()
"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-31~1.3/bin/x64/R" --vanilla CMD SHLIB foo.c 

Warning message:
running command 'make -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-31~1.3/etc/x64/Makeconf" -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-31~1.3/share/make/winshlib.mk" SHLIB="foo.dll" WIN=64 TCLBIN=64 OBJECTS="foo.o"' had status 127 
Error: Command failed (1)
I use PC computer with Windows 7. My R version is 3.1.3 and for RStudio I use version 0.98.1103. 

Can anyone please help me to figure out how to solve this error?

Any help will be greatly appreciated,


Ayala

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Error when running has_devel()
parts:
This is a known problem - I'm working on devtools this week, so will
hopefully have a CRAN release soon to fix it.
Hadley
